# Resources

Each resource is a polling snapshot, templated by slot. Read `primary` for
single-device flows, `left` / `right` when two units are connected.

## Slot-templated resources

### `voltra://device/{slot}/current`

**Current device state (per slot)**

Polling snapshot of the connected Voltra device for a slot (connection, weight, training mode, battery). Templated by {slot} — pass `primary` for single-device flows or `left`/`right` for bilateral.

Content type: `application/json`.

### `voltra://session/{slot}/active`

**Active workout session (per slot)**

Polling snapshot of the active session metadata (sessionId, startedAt, exercise, accumulated setIds). Templated by {slot}. Returns { active: false } when no session is in progress.

Content type: `application/json`.

### `voltra://set/{slot}/active`

**Active set with rep buffer (per slot)**

Polling snapshot of the in-progress set (setId, sessionId, startedAt, reps[]). Templated by {slot}. Returns { active: false } when no set is in progress.

Content type: `application/json`.

## Legacy unslotted aliases

Each template carries an unslotted alias that reads the primary slot, kept so
single-device clients written before slots keep working.

### `voltra://device/current`

**Current device state (primary slot, legacy alias)**

Backwards-compatible alias for `voltra://device/primary/current`. Reads the primary slot.

Content type: `application/json`.

### `voltra://session/active`

**Active workout session (primary slot, legacy alias)**

Backwards-compatible alias for `voltra://session/primary/active`.

Content type: `application/json`.

### `voltra://set/active`

**Active set (primary slot, legacy alias)**

Backwards-compatible alias for `voltra://set/primary/active`.

Content type: `application/json`.
